reason: Issue #341 and spec 060 port Calma to onmars, changing its resolved palette, surface, type, motion and component tokens. Existing Material 3 token values stay byte-identical after resolution. Adds --ki-motion-easing-emphasized-out, --ki-surface-tooltip-inverse, --ki-text-tooltip-inverse and --ki-elevation-none. Deprecates --ki-motion-easing-spring in 0.1.0 for removal in 1.0.0 per spec 041 and moves the checkbox and radio CSS references to its replacement. The cumulative declaration supersedes 317-321-loading-hint-touch and retains its declared deltas. Explicit effective-value changes and the earlier cumulative delta are MAJOR since 0.0.0. No package is published.
